texts.preamble: Pappu Sahu vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 22 March, 2018 1 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh Principal Seat At Jabalpur Cr.R.No.1233 of 2018 ( Pappu Sahu vs. State of M.P.) Dated:-22.3.2018
texts.facts: A perusal of the record reveals that the petitioner stands convicted under Sections 16 (1) (A) (i) read with section 7 (1) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and has been sentenced to undergo R.I. for a period of 6 months and fine in the sum of Rs.1,000/- with default stipulation. It has been submitted on behalf of the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner has been in custody since the date of the judgment of the appellate Court ie. 12.03.2018; therefore, it has been prayed that the jail sentence of the petitioner be suspended.
